Okay, first @bot is ready.

I turned the way I review pitch decks into a Grok Bot.

Give it your deck. It reads the whole thing first, tells you what it thinks your company is and the story it heard, then helps you work through it.

Pitch Deck Coach: https://t.co/Rl2fi6nqRK
